title: Session/cache eviction pressure
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Apply session eviction pressure; distinguish acceptable cache misses from lost required state.
sourceAcceptance: Eviction effects are visible; required state survives through the approved durable contract or fails explicitly.
preconditions: A modern browser opens the standalone HTML, CSS and JavaScript; no server or account.
Two fixed synthetic cache entries contain one required session and one optional recomputable catalog tile.
Required session revision 3, cart synthetic-bolt:2 and step review are the exact continuity oracle.
The required session expires at logical tick 4; the optional tile at tick 2; equality expires an entry.
Current, missing, stale and unavailable durable records are supplied synthetic fixtures, not observations.
D-S031 is a source-parent prerequisite; this independent A card supplies fixed externalized state without completing that parent.
actions: Choose a bounded capacity/TTL preset, durable evidence and required-miss response policy.
Apply pressure and inspect each eviction cause and remaining cache entry.
Check continuity and inspect exact required fields, misses, recomputations and recoveries.
Compare measured SUCCESS, FAILURE or UNKNOWN with a learning prediction and retain the evidence.
Start a new attempt keeping history, or explicitly reset all local memory.
assertions: Capacity shrink and TTL equality expose required and optional eviction causes separately.
Only exact required session fields from a cache hit or approved current durable record permit SUCCESS.
An optional cache miss is acceptable when the fixed derived tile is recomputed and required state is preserved.
Missing or stale durable state fails explicitly and counts an interrupted synthetic journey.
A synthetic status 200 with an empty required record is FAILURE, never successful continuity.
Unavailable durable evidence on a required miss yields UNKNOWN rather than success or invented loss certainty.
All 32 fixed combinations are deterministic; strict exact inputs, ordered actions and deeply frozen detached snapshots are guarded.
Six completed attempts retain inputs, eviction causes, required-state comparisons and trace without silent history eviction.
Actual browser checks cover keyboard operation, validation errors, reset, failures, unknowns and enforced CSP.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine behavioral RED and before implementation

testRuntime.purpose: Existing Node22 test tooling only; not production Node24 certification.

limits: Synthetic sessions, identities and data only; no real authentication, credentials or management calls.
No actual session eviction, cache behavior, durable storage, timing, recovery or uninterrupted-service certification.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity registration, deployment, expenditure or production Node24 validation.
An explicit error prevents empty-state substitution but remains an interrupted synthetic journey.
History lives only in browser memory; reset or reload clears it.
B-S074 and source parent D-S074, including D-S031 prerequisites, remain incomplete.
The published browser helper retains its documented unattended lifecycle limitation; the abandoned prototype is unqualified.
One frozen S unit; tests, evidence, tooling and refinement earn no additional units; parent alone accepts.
